content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets with crypto payments means leveraging decentralized finance to bypass traditional payment platforms that impose high fees and restrictions. For instance, while Gumroad takes a hefty 10% cut from each sale, NOWPayments charges merely 0.5%. This difference can lead to significant savings; if you sell a $97 product and make 100 sales a month, you save $921 just on fees. This model is crucial for creators in financially isolated regions who need a reliable way to monetize their work without losing a large portion of their earnings to middlemen.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for selling design assets using crypto payments incorporates a combination of free tools and services. For hosting, you can use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which provide a solid foundation for your online store without any cost. The backend logic can be managed with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, enabling automated processing of orders. NOWPayments integrates seamlessly to handle crypto transactions, providing real-time conversion to USD at the moment of transaction. This architecture ensures that creators maintain full control and ownership over their content and sales processes.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is specifically designed for creators in countries where conventional payment processors are either unavailable or unreliable. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or digital music, the architecture allows you to bypass financial barriers and securely collect payments. This setup is ideal for digital creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other regions facing similar restrictions. By utilizing this infrastructure, you can ensure a seamless sales process for your customers while keeping the lion's share of your earnings.
Lower fees mean higher profits — save more with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

At the core of this system are several key components that work harmoniously to provide a seamless selling experience. First, the hosting service like GitHub Pages offers a robust platform for your digital storefront. Next, the backend logic powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script automates order processing and delivery. NOWPayments then facilitates crypto transactions, ensuring you can accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Together, these tools create a resilient and efficient sales infrastructure that empowers creators.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your design assets with crypto payments, follow these concrete steps. First, set up your hosting with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, create your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions effectively. Load your digital products and ensure they are ready for customers. Finally, test the entire system to confirm that orders are processed smoothly. With these steps, you can launch your sovereign digital commerce stack and take control of your online sales.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automate your sales process and focus on creation, not administration.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those looking to expand their digital sales capabilities, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all six blueprints and seven templates necessary for building a sovereign digital commerce stack. This comprehensive kit allows you to deploy your system quickly and efficiently. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell ebooks online by using a decentralized commerce infrastructure that accepts crypto payments. This eliminates the need for traditional payment processors and allows you to retain more of your profits.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The most effective way to sell digital downloads without incurring platform fees is to use automated crypto payment systems like NOWPayments. These systems have significantly lower fees compared to traditional platforms.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by setting up your own online store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, integrated with NOWPayments for crypto transactions.
What are the benefits of using crypto payments for digital sales?
Using crypto payments offers lower transaction fees, no need for buyer accounts, and immediate payment confirmation. This streamlines the selling process and enhances customer experience.
Is there a way to automate delivery of digital products?

Automating the delivery of digital products can be accomplished using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. These tools allow you to manage orders and deliver files instantly upon payment confirmation.
